mil5.1.5:1.2: Sirirājena yācakassa cakkhūni dinnāni, andhassa sato puna dibbacakkhūni uppannānīti. Etam-pi vacanaṃ sakasaṭaṃ saniggahaṃ sadosaṃ. Hetusamugghāte ahetusmiṃ avatthumhi na-tthi dibbacakkhussa uppādo ti Sutte vuttaṃ. Yadi bhante Nāgasena Sivirājena yācakassa cakkhūni dinnāni, tena hi: puna dibbacakkhūni uppannānīti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.1.5:1.3: Yadi dibbacakkhūni uppannāni, tena hi: Sivirājena yācakassa cakkhūni dinnānīti yaṃ vacanaṃ tam-pi micchā.
mil5.1.5:1.4: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho, gaṇṭhito pi gaṇṭhitaro, vedhato pi vedhataro, gahanato pi gahanataro, so tavānuppatto, tattha chandam-abhijanehi nibbāhanāya paravādānaṃ niggahāyāti. -
mil5.1.5:2.1: Dinnāni mahārāja Sivirājena yācakassa cakkhūm. tattha mā vimatiṃ uppādehi; puna dibbāni ca cakkhūni uppannāni, tatthāpi mā vimatiṃ janehīti. -
mil5.1.5:2.2: Api nu kho bhante Nāgasena hetusamugghāte ahetusmiṃ avatthumhi dibbacakkhu uppajjatīti. -
mil5.1.5:2.4: Kim-pana bhante ettha kāraṇaṃ yena kāraṇena hetusamugghāte ahetusmiṃ avatthumhi dibbacakkhu uppajjati, ingha tāva kāraṇena maṃ saññāpehīti.
mil5.1.5:3.1: Kim-pana mahārāja atthi loke saccaṃ nāma yena saccavādino saccakiriyaṃ karontīti. -
mil5.1.5:3.2: Āma bhante, atthi loke saccaṃ nāma, saccena bhante Nāgasena saccavādino saccakiriyaṃ katvā devaṃ vassāpenti, aggiṃ nibbāpenti, visaṃ paṭihananti, aññam-pi vividhaṃ kattabbaṃ karontīti.
mil5.1.5:3.3: Tena hi mahārāja yujjati sameti: Sivirājassa saccabalena dibbacakkhūni uppannānīti, saccabalena mahārāja avatthumhi dibbacakkhu uppajjati, saccaṃ yeva tattha vatthu bhavati dibbacakkhussa uppādāya.
mil5.1.5:4.1: Yathā mahārāja ye keci siddhā saccam anugāyanti: mahāmegho pavassatūti, tesaṃ saha saccam-anugītena mahāmegho pavassati; api nu kho mahārāja atthi ākāse vassahetu sannicito yena hetunā mahāmegho pavassatīti. -
mil5.1.5:4.2: Na hi bhante, saccaṃ yeva tattha hetu bhavati mahato meghassa pavassanāyāti. -
mil5.1.5:4.3: Evam-eva kho mahārāja na-tthi tassa pakatihetu, saccaṃ yev' ettha vatthu bhavati dibbacakkhussa uppādāyāti.
mil5.1.5:5.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja ye keci siddhā saccamanugāyanti: jalita-pajjalita-mahāaggikkhandho paṭinivattatūti, tesaṃ saha saccam-anugītena jalita-pajjalita-mahāaggikkhandho khaṇena paṭinivattati,
mil5.1.5:5.2: api nu kho mahārāja atthi tasmiṃ jalita-pajjalite mahāaggikkhandhe hetu sannicito yena hetunā jalita-pajjalita-mahāaggikkhandho khaṇena paṭinivattatīti. -
mil5.1.5:5.3: Na hi bhante, saccaṃ yeva tattha vatthu hoti tassa jalita-pajjalitassa mahāaggikkhandhassa khaṇena paṭinivattanāyāti. -
mil5.1.5:5.4: Evam-eva kho mahārāja na-tthi tassa pakatihetu, saccaṃ yev' ettha vatthu bhavati dibbacakkhussa uppādāyāti.
mil5.1.5:6.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja ye keci siddhā saccamanugāyanti: visaṃ halāhalaṃ agadaṃ bhavatūti,
mil5.1.5:6.2: tesaṃ saha saccam-anugītena visaṃ halāhalaṃ khaṇena agadaṃ bhavati, api nu kho mahārāja atthi tasmiṃ halāhalavise hetu sannicito yena hetunā visaṃ halāhalaṃ khaṇena agadaṃ bhavatīti. -
mil5.1.5:6.3: Na hi bhante, saccaṃ yeva tattha hetu bhavati visassa halāhalassa khaṇena paṭighātāyāti.
mil5.1.5:6.4: -Evam-eva kho mahārāja vinā pakatihetuṃ saccaṃ yev' ettha vatthu bhavati dibbacakkhussa uppādāyāti.
mil5.1.5:7.1: Catunnam-pi mahārāja ariyasaccānaṃ paṭivedhāya na-tth' aññaṃ vatthu, saccaṃ vatthuṃ karitvā cattāri ariyasaccāni paṭivijjhantīti.
mil5.1.5:7.2: Atthi mahārāja Cīnavisaye Cīnarājā, so mahāsamudde baliṃ kātukāmo catumāse catumāse saccakiriyaṃ katvā sīharathena antomahāsamudde yojanaṃ pavisati, tassa rathasīsassa purato mahāvārikkhandho paṭikkamati, nikkhantassa puna ottharati, api nu kho mahārāja so mahāsamuddo sadevamanussena pi lokena pakatikāyabalena sakkā paṭikkamāpetun-ti. -
mil5.1.5:7.3: Atiparittake pi bhante taḷāke udakaṃ na sakkā sadevamanussena pi lokena pakatikāyabalena paṭikkamāpetuṃ, kiṃ pana mahāsamudde udakan-ti. -
mil5.1.5:7.4: Iminā pi mahārāja kāraṇena saccabalaṃ ñātabbaṃ, na-tthi taṃ ṭhānaṃ yaṃ saccena na pattabban-ti.
mil5.1.5:8.1: Nagare mahārāja Pāṭaliputte Asoko dhammarājā sanegama-jānapada-amacca-bhaṭabala-mahāmattehi parivuto Gangaṃ nadiṃ navasalilasampuṇṇaṃ samatittikaṃ samabharitaṃ pañcayojanasatāyāmaṃ yojanaputhulaṃ sandamānaṃ disvā amacce evam-āha:
mil5.1.5:8.2: Atthi koci bhaṇe samattho [yo] imaṃ Mahāgangaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpetun-ti.
mil5.1.5:9.1: Tasmiṃ yeva Gangākūle ṭhitā Bindumatī nāma gaṇikā assosi: raññā kira evaṃ vuttaṃ:
mil5.1.5:9.2: sakkā nu kho imaṃ Mahāgangaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpetun-ti. Sā evam-āha: Ahaṃ
mil5.1.5:9.3: hi nagare Pāṭaliputte gaṇikā rūpūpajīvinī antimajīvikā, mama tāva rājā saccakiriyaṃ passatūti.
mil5.1.5:9.4: Atha sā saccakiriyaṃ akāsi. Saha tassā saccakiriyāya khaṇena sā Mahāgangā galagalantī paṭisotaṃ sandittha, mahato janakāyassa passato.
mil5.1.5:10.1: Atha rājā Mahāgangāya āvaṭṭaūmivegajanitaṃ halāhalasaddaṃ sutvā vimhito acchariyabbhutajāto amacce evamāha:
mil5.1.5:10.3: Bindumatī mahārāja gaṇikā tava vacanaṃ sutvā saccakiriyaṃ akāsi, tassā saccakiriyāya Mahāgangā ubbhamukhā sandatīti.
mil5.1.5:11.1: Atha saṃviggahadayo rājā turitaturito sayaṃ gantvā taṃ gaṇikaṃ pucchi:
mil5.1.5:11.2: Saccaṃ kira je tayā saccakiriyāya ayaṃ Gangā paṭisotaṃ sandāpitā ti.
mil5.1.5:11.5: Kin-te tattha balaṃ atthi, ko vā te vacanaṃ ādiyati anummatto, kena tvaṃ balena imaṃ Mahāgangaṃ patisotaṃ sandāpesīti.
mil5.1.5:11.7: Saccabalenāhaṃ mahārāja imaṃ Mahāgangaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpesin-ti.
mil5.1.5:11.9: Kin-te saccabalaṃ atthi coriyā dhuttiyā asatiyā chinnikāya pāpiyā bhinnasīmāya atikkantikāya andhajanavilopikāyāti.
mil5.1.5:11.10: Saccaṃ mahārāja tādisikā ahaṃ, tādisikāya pi me mahārāja saccakiriyā atthi yāyāhaṃ icchamānā sadevakam-pi lokaṃ parivatteyyan-ti.
mil5.1.5:11.12: Katamā pana sā hoti saccakiriyā, ingha maṃ sāvehīti.
mil5.1.5:11.13: Yo me mahārāja dhanaṃ deti khattiyo vā brāhmaṇo vā vesso vā suddo vā añño vā koci tesaṃ samakaṃ yeva upaṭṭhahāmi, khattiyo ti viseso na-tthi, suddo ti atimaññanā na-tthi, anunayapaṭighavippamuttā dhanasāmikaṃ paricarāmi, esā me deva saccakiriyā yāyāhaṃ imaṃ Mahāgangaṃ paṭisotaṃ sandāpesin-ti.
mil5.1.5:12.1: Iti pi mahārāja sacce thitā na kañci atthaṃ na vindanti.
mil5.1.5:12.2: Dinnāni ca mahārāja Sivirājena yācakassa cakkhūni, dibbacakkhūni ca uppannāni, tañ-ca saccakiriyāya.
mil5.1.5:12.4: Maṃsacakkhusmiṃ naṭṭhe ahetusmiṃ avatthumhi na-tthi dibbacakkhussa uppādo ti,
mil5.1.5:12.5: taṃ bhāvanāmayaṃ cakkhuṃ sandhāya vuttan-ti evam-etaṃ mahārāja dhārehīti. -
mil5.1.5:12.6: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, sunibbeṭhito pañho, suniddiṭṭho niggaho, sumadditā parappavādā, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti
